text.en: NASA Glenn · Ideal Rocket Equation: ideal change in velocity equals equivalent exhaust velocity times the natural logarithm of initial to final mass.
text.zh: NASA 格伦中心《理想火箭方程》：理想速度变化等于等效排气速度乘以初始质量与最终质量比的自然对数。

note.en: Official page reopened by the build parent on 2026-10-27. Formula reference only; the page explicitly neglects rocket weight and aerodynamic drag in the ideal derivation. S90 supplies this topic’s invented masses and exhaust speed, not NASA performance data.
note.zh: 施工主代理于 2026-10-27 重新打开官方页。只用于公式；页面理想推导明确暂不计火箭重量和气动阻力。本题假想质量与排气速度来自 S90，不是 NASA 性能数据。

text.en: Atlas Saturn V teaching model design study, 2026-10-27. Apollo 11 configuration with simplified internals. Scene units are metres; stack height 111 m, lower body diameter 10.06 m and upper body diameter 6.61 m. Independent ideal experiment: effective exhaust speed 3000 m/s; dry hardware 100 kg; payload 100, 200 or 300 kg; propellant 200, 400 or 600 kg; optional inert hardware 100 kg.
text.zh: Atlas 土星五号教学模型设计研究，2026-10-27。阿波罗 11 号构型，内部简化。场景单位为米；全高 111 m，下段主体直径 10.06 m、上段 6.61 m。独立理想实验：有效排气速度 3000 m/s；干结构 100 kg；载荷 100、200 或 300 kg；推进剂 200、400 或 600 kg；可另带 100 kg 惰性结构。

note.en: Original design, not measured Saturn V performance. docs/61-saturn-v-content-spec.md §§3.0–3.7 and shared simulation-table.json. mf=100+payload+(carry-inert?100:0); m0=mf+propellant; delta-v=3000 ln(m0/mf). The 18 complete input combinations are precomputed without rounding; UI rounds to two decimals. Default 200/600/false gives 900 kg, 300 kg and 3295.836866004329 m/s; carry=true gives 1000 kg, 400 kg and 2748.872195622465 m/s. Ignores drag, gravity losses, changing exhaust conditions and a real flight trajectory. Poses, separation distances, widened pipes and visual flow speeds are explanatory design values. Flow speeds 0.8/0.8/1.6 m/s are visual only.
note.zh: 原创设计，不是土星五号性能测量。见 docs/61-saturn-v-content-spec.md §3.0–3.7 与共享 simulation-table.json。mf=100+载荷+(额外结构开时100)；m0=mf+推进剂；理想速度变化=3000 ln(m0/mf)。18 个完整输入组合预先计算、内部不取整，界面保留两位小数。默认 200/600/关时为 900 kg、300 kg、3295.836866004329 m/s；开额外结构时为 1000 kg、400 kg、2748.872195622465 m/s。忽略阻力、重力损失、排气条件变化与真实飞行轨迹。姿态、分离距离、放宽管线及流动速度是解释用设计值；0.8/0.8/1.6 m/s 只供画面可读。
